tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī bh+ya:

'dir bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gser chos las byung ba'i rgyun khyer sgrub thabs ni/ 'byor na mdun du sman raka gtor ma nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ tshogs zhing gsal btab la/ kyai: phyogs bcu'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog bdag la dgongs: 'gro rnams skyob pa'i mgon dang dpung mdzod cig: dus 'di nas bzung rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar: mgon po mchog gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul: nyams chag nyes ltung bsags rnams mthol zhing bshags: dus gsum dge bar gyur la rjes yi rang: bla med theg chen chos 'khor bskor du gsol: rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol: bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo: skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi: sngon chad rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rmad byung ltar: de bzhin bdag gis dus 'di nas brtsam bya: 'gro ba yongs kyi bla mar bdag gyur cig: ces pas rgyud sbyangs te tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na bsang sbyang*/ oṃ: snang srid 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i rdzas: ā: rnam dag lha tshogs dgyes pa skong bar byed: hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nus bcud ldan: ho: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: zhes byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ stong pa nyid dang snying rje che'i rang bzhin// zung 'jug hrīḥlas rgyu yi he ru ka /ma 'gag rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang*// dwangs gsal 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong yangs su// rang rig pad+ma badz+ra dmar gsal mdangs// dmar mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis// rdor dril ral gri bhañdza bum pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin lha lcam gsang ba'i yum// dmar mo ḍā ru dung dmar 'dzin dang sbyor// gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'bar ba'i chas kyis brjid// bud+dha thod phreng mi bskyod rdo rje rtsal// pad+ma dbang chen rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal// mdog dmar me phreng sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang*// rta mgrin phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa// rang rang yum 'khor bka' nyan sprul par bcas// rnam rol ma 'gag sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin// gang 'dul mos pa'i dpal du lham mer gsal/

hūm̐ hrī: rang byung thugs rje ma 'gag rol pa'i sku: spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang: thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol cing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya e ā ral+li hrīng hrīng: pheṃ pheṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tsit+ta badz+ra dz+nyā na pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: hūm̐ hrī: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: me tog bdug spos mar me zhal zas dri: sgra dbyangs ar+ghaṃ la sogs mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang ba bla med dgyes mchod 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pū dza ho: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza ho: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ nai ri ti ba su ta tsit+ta pū dza ho: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ hrī: phyi nang gzhan gsum lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: byed pa kun ston rnam 'phrul yongs kyi mdzod: 'khor 'das rang grol bde chen g.yung drung sku: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas dmigs ni/ lha tshogs thugs kar pad zla nyi steng hrī: /sngags phreng bskor ba'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas// snod bcud rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i zhing du gyur// tshur 'dus mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes dgongs 'dus rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa spyi dril 'bring po ci nus bzla/ shes shing spro na spyi dril chen mo dang gtso dgu'i snying po sogs kyang bzla chog /lus dkyil byed na ngag bzlas de dag gtsor mi byed par 'bru gsum rlung dang sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas bya/

gang ltar yang mjug tu mchod bstod mdor bsdus/ kha skong dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying brjod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'od gsal chos nyid du bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis slar rang byung gnyug ma'i lhar ldang*/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol par bltas la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyis// sgo gsum gyis bsags dge ba ji snyed pa// byang chub chen po'i dbyings su bsngo bar bgyi// bla med don gyi 'bras bu mchog thob shog / ces bsngo smon bya'o// zhes chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa dang kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i rgyun khyer la slar yang gzhug mthud kyis gsal bar byed pa po pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha: badz+ra ma hā kro dha shān+ti ka: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sarba sid+dhi: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta: dz+nyā na satwa a mi dhe wa: ma ma tsit+ta saṃ bha wa a dhiṣ+ṭhā naṃ: ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā: spyi dril chen mo'o// //
